note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were contested: Ardkeen, Kilmood, Kircubbin and Portaferry (Belfast Telegraph, 17 May 1967, p. 4; results Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 4). The other sitting members were returned unopposed, except that Mr. W. F. T. McMordie, the outgoing chairman, was succeeded by Henry John Cromie and Wesley Campbell by Richard Desmond Warwick; the report names neither's division. Polled. Sitting member re-elected; majority 73. The vote figures are cut off at the edge of the printed column, so none are recorded. Mr. McKeag is described as a farmer of Lisbarnett (Belfast Telegraph, 17 May 1967, p. 4).
